series_start_reason: 2023Q1 is the first quarter with SKYSONA revenue: the FY2023 Form 10-K prints the 2022 SKYSONA column as a dash, and the 2024Q1 Form 10-Q prints 2023Q1 as 2,296 thousand. SKYSONA was approved in September 2022; the first commercial revenue followed in 2023Q1.
series_end_reason: bluebird bio filed its last periodic report, the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2025 (filed 2025-05-14), and then a Form 15 on 2025-06-12 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1293971/000119312525139516/d13380d1512g.htm) after its acquisition by Carlyle and SK Capital (Beacon Parent Holdings). No 2025Q2 report exists.
search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1293971 (bluebird bio) via data.sec.gov/submissions; fetched every 10-Q/10-K and every 8-K item 2.02 exhibit filed 2022-10 to 2025-06.

The earnings releases and the 2023 Forms 10-Q print only total product revenue; the by-therapy table with a SKYSONA row first appears in the 2024 filings (FY2023 10-K and 2024 10-Qs). 2023Q1-Q3 are therefore read from the prior-year columns of the 2024 10-Qs (direct_prior_year_column), and both fourth quarters are derived as full year less nine months. The 2023 nine-month total of the three prior-year quarters (2,296 + 2,657 + 7,430 = 12,383) equals the printed nine-months-2023 column, and 2024 (0 + 4,943 + 2,487 + 2,487 = 9,917) equals the FY2024 10-K.
Zero quarters (2024Q1, 2025Q1) are printed dashes in the SKYSONA row and are kept as 0.
Prior-year check: the prior-year comparative column of 4 quarterly quotes equals the figure recorded for that earlier quarter from its own filing.
